about.title: About
about.creativeText: All of them. Evangelical? Yeah, I'm cool with that. Catholic? Sure, why not! Umbanda? Well I'll be damned... Candomblé? Love it! Oh you're a spiritist? Yeah yeah, Tuesday's session was good. Oh a Buddha showed up — you good with that? Yep, that works too. Look, the person who has no enemies — everybody loves that person. That's rule number one for any politician worth their salt. From rich to poor, from black to white, from tall to short — I shake everybody's hand exactly the same way. You know why? Because the one who shoots in every direction, hits something eventually. And when they hit — they hit good. Ah, but you're still young… I've got an insane amount of spiritual protection — through the orixá, the saint, the Buddha, the hindu gods. I don't even know from where exactly, but everybody loves me there...!
about.langText: Multilingual people shift personalities without noticing, depending on the language they're speaking. Each language carries different cultural connections and ways of seeing the world. 🙂‍↕️
